facts.summary: Phase 2 trial showed no benefit over placebo, high GI-driven discontinuations · Phase 2 · TTI-101 in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: After reviewing the preliminary safety data and exploratory efficacy results, including changes in Forced Vital Capacity (FVC), the Company concluded that the study did not meet its goals.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Preliminary analysis of exploratory efficacy showed no statistically significant differences between placebo and treatment arms.
evidence.safety: Discontinuation rates among the TTI-101 population were primarily driven by gastrointestinal adverse events, with higher rates of events and discontinuations among patients on concurrent nintedanib.
